response.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT ma.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major AS ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.department), department_shares AS (SELECT department, income_count, 1.0 * income_count / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT income_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM department_shares) SELECT SUM(income_count) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share
